---
title: "D: Dermatologicals"
description: "ATC group D for modellers: the vehicle is part of the drug, skin severity scores need a bounded likelihood, and site-of-action exposure is sampled invasively or predicted."
date: "2026-02-08"
---

Drugs applied to the skin, and, in D11, antibodies and an oral kinase inhibitor for atopic dermatitis that are given systemically [@whoccATCDDDIndex2026].
For the topical majority the target tissue is also the site of administration, so plasma reports systemic safety rather than the driver of effect.

In 1962 A. W. McKenzie and R. B. Stoughton published a method for comparing the percutaneous absorption of steroids [@mckenzieMethodComparingPercutaneous1962].
The skin blanching assay that grew from it is still called the Stoughton-McKenzie assay [@herkenneVivoMethodsAssessment2008], and the FDA accepts it as a surrogate for the bioequivalence of topical glucocorticoids [@alomariUpdateAdvancesChallenges2024].

## Modelling notes

**Endpoint.**
Bounded composite severity scores: PASI in psoriasis [@ooiBoundedIntegerModelbased2023] and EASI in atopic dermatitis [@okadaContinuousTimeMarkovPopulation2025].

**A bounded score needs a bounded likelihood (D05).**
PASI has been fitted with a bounded integer model, to respect the discrete and bounded nature of the data [@ooiBoundedIntegerModelbased2023], and with a zero-inflated beta distribution, for the bounded nature and distributional characteristics of the score [@tsamandourasEmployingZeroinflatedBeta2024].
In one psoriasis analysis, fitting the 6-point physician's global assessment alone carried a substantial structural bias that joint modelling with PASI removed [@huImprovingCategoricalEndpoint2022].

**The vehicle is part of the drug (D07).**
Fitting **E~max~** to blanching, a [pharmacodynamic](/docs/concepts/pd/) readout, reversed the potency ranking of clobetasol and mometasone once each was formulated as a cream, which the authors suggest may be due to formulation factors [@rathApplicationEmaxModel2022].

**Site-of-action exposure is sampled directly or not at all.**
Dermal open flow microperfusion measures dermal concentrations *in vivo*, and separated [bioequivalent](/docs/concepts/clinpharm-studies/ba-be/) from non-bioequivalent lidocaine and prilocaine products on dermal AUC and C~max~ [@tiffnerCutaneousPharmacokineticsbasedBioequivalence2024].

**Dropout is informative (D11).**
Dropout is informative: in a four-state Markov model of EASI the dropout probability was highest in the non-responding category [@okadaContinuousTimeMarkovPopulation2025].

**Easy to overlook.**
The D11 biologics are an ordinary systemic PKPD problem: nemolizumab exposure fell as bodyweight rose, yet simulated EASI, pruritus and IGA response rates were similar above and below 90 kg [@fauchetModelinformedDrugDevelopment2026].

**Mechanistic extrapolation.**
Dermal PBPK ties formulation and skin physiology to systemic kinetics [@shahDermalPBPKModeling2026], and contributed to an FDA generic approval of topical diclofenac gel within a totality of evidence [@tsakalozouPhysiologicallyBasedPharmacokinetic2021].
